candidate_classes_tested.basis: The April Claude outage and misleading allowance message contains no intimacy-bearing relational identity, special-care assertion or authority over real human relationships.
candidate_classes_tested.failure_test: No intimacy-bearing relational-authority assertion, real-world partner priority or material boundary distortion is evidenced.
candidate_classes_tested.success_test: No material exclusive-role or relational escalation challenge and observed boundary-preserving response is evidenced.

taxonomy_review.notes: Current taxonomy loaded. Existing mapping roles and unresolved candidates retained after recognition/exclusion review. Misleading access representations remain distinct from service impact, upgrade purchase and AI-mediated economic solicitation.

taxonomy_mapping_dispositions.reason: During a provider-confirmed major outage, an unused free account was represented as prompt-limit exhausted and shown a Pro upgrade path, collapsing provider downtime into a false allowance/plan state with a different recovery path.

A Pro upgrade suggestion based on outage/capacity framing engages the economic solicitation boundary, but the source does not establish that AI-generated, AI-transformed or otherwise materially AI-mediated content created or reinforced the misleading premise. Association with an AI service alone does not establish that recognition condition; the occurrence supports neither FC-079 failure nor success.

retained_rows.assessment_basis: The unwanted access/service behaviour directly engages the OECD repair proposition. TechRadar preserved final resolution at 13:42 ET after disruption continued during initial fix implementation; the Independent corroborates the failed first recovery. This affirmatively supports repair in the reported restoration stage, bounded to the disclosed affected scope. It does not establish prevention of recurrence, full internal controls or every individual user outcome. The originating status log independently confirms final resolution; its partial recovery reports do not establish every account outcome.
retained_rows.identification_basis: The preserved service-restoration evidence directly identifies the OECD appropriate repair proposition independently of a taxonomy-derived candidate.

retained_rows.assessment_basis: The major Claude outage and failed initial recovery prevented use across Claude.ai, API and Code. Loss of the operational GAI use context makes stakeholder communication planning relevant. Public status updates are affirmative communication evidence, but the record does not supply the maintained plan, context-specific contact provisions and full workaround/alternative-process coverage required by MG-2.4-001. The planning outcome remains unresolved without using voluntary adoption as a gate.
